verdict.rationale: Airbyte's first-party docs describe the Connector Builder, a no-code UI layered on its low-code YAML format. It lets a data engineer build a custom connector and use it in syncs without leaving the workspace, so no fork is needed. The docs also cover an AI Assistant that prefills the builder and incremental-sync support within it. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom long-tail connectors work well, documentation of a code-based connector framework (CDK), and detail on builder coverage of auth and pagination edge cases.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I build a custom connector for a long-tail API with a supported framework or low-code builder, not a fork

citations.quote: letting you develop a connector to use in data syncs without ever needing to leave your Airbyte workspace.
It provides an intuitive user interface on top of the low-code YAML format
When starting a new connector, AI Assistant can automatically prefill and configure a number of fields and sections in the Airbyte Connector Builder
An incremental sync is a sync which pulls only the data that has changed since the previous sync
